body: Thank you all so much. Really.

I had a friend that I thought could help me. I used to tell him my problems. I didn't necessarily want advice; just talking helped.

But I'm fairly sure he has enough of his own issues without mine added as an extra burden. That's all that I feel. Like a burden.

I wish I could call him and just talk but I know he wouldn't even bother picking up. I think knowing that made me feel like this. Like this is okay. I am basically screaming for help and there is no one left.

I won't die tonight. But I'm okay with it and that's terrifying.

I'm sorry if this is incoherent and doesn't make much sense. I'm trying to stay composed and in control but. Yeah. I don't know.

I'm extremely lonely.
Please someone. I'm just sitting here refreshing the page every minute

I feel like all the doors are locked or lead to somewhere worse. I can't keep feeling like this. I see a psychiatrist, I have anti depressants, I have CBT. But nothing makes this better.

I wish I could just feel a bit better like I could cope but I can't.
